Package logic

Class Dish

java.lang.Object
logic.Dish
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class Dish extends Object implements Serializable, Cloneable
The Dish class represents a dish in a restaurant menu. It implements the Serializable and Cloneable interfaces to allow dishes to be serialized and cloned. Each dish has attributes like ID, name, type, size, price, roast level, and remark.

The class provides various constructors for creating a dish with different combinations of attributes, along with standard getters and setters for accessing and modifying the dish's properties.

Example usage: 

 
 Dish dish = new Dish("Espresso", "Coffee", "Small", 2.50);
 dish.setRemark("No sugar");
 System.out.println(dish);
